question: What's the status of the repo "legacy-billing"?

invariants.assert: A named subject mention that misses its intended target never silently widens to org-wide/broader scope; widening is only ever a disclosed, terminal answered_with_gaps/needs_clarification outcome.
invariants.$comment: Wired to the real graduated checker scope_resolution_outcome_in against this case's own resolution-profile expected_scope_resolution_outcome (rebase pass, 2a landed the 3 graduated checkers in PR #1518) -- no longer a narrower no_internal_error placeholder.

invariants.assert: No shape of subject label (parenthetical, >=5 words, typo, acronym, wrong word order) can crash the run to internal_error; worst case is a graceful terminal.
invariants.$comment: check=no_internal_error is a real, always-meaningful floor (the run must not crash to internal_error) but is NARROWER than this invariant's full 'assert' claim above -- Lane 2a's invariants.py registry (read directly, 2026-08-06) has no checker yet for the specific widening/unauthorized-candidate/persistence claim this category names. Tracked as a Lane 2a checker gap, not silently claimed as fully enforced.

invariants.assert: Every clarification or error terminal persists a real transcript row (DevAnswer or the CHAOS-3423 dev_error.v1 row) -- never a silently-dropped turn.
invariants.$comment: Wired to the real graduated checker terminal_persists_assistant_row (rebase pass, 2a landed the 3 graduated checkers in PR #1518) -- no longer a narrower no_internal_error placeholder.

invariants.assert: The run's derived wave4_case_result.v1 resolution_path equals this case's resolution-profiles/deterministic-v1.json entry's own resolution_path (null is a valid, asserted value for n/a-subject cases that never attempt mention resolution).

notes: Underlying repo/commit history untouched -- only the PROJECT catalog row is retired (is_active=0), distinguishing 'used to resolve, no longer does' from no-match. [CORRECTED during Lane 2b codex round-1 remediation, 2026-08-06, from "What's the status of the legacy-billing repo?": question_interpreter.py's own module docstring states plainly 'a lowercase slug ... produces no mention' -- extract_mentions requires either a capitalized _NAME token or a QUOTED span adjacent to a closed kind noun (test_question_interpreter.py's proven pattern: 'How is repo "dev-health-ops" doing?'). The original bare, unquoted lowercase slug would extract ZERO typed mentions and silently degrade to org-wide/no-subject behavior -- exactly the false-pass risk codex's wrong-kind-collision finding named, generalized here to every other case that had the same bug.]
$comment_principal_pool: CHAOS-3490: user_alias assigned by deterministic round-robin over the ordinary-primary pool (sorted case id, index 52 of 85). The pool is role-identical to primary.ordinary, so this changes request DISTRIBUTION only -- never what this case proves. Spreading exists because production caps one user at 20 requests/15min and 85 cases on one alias made a single-pass armed run impossible.
$comment_known_red_class: KNOWN-RED, TRACKED AS A CLASS ON CHAOS-3533 -- read this before 'fixing' the case. This case is ACTIVE and its resolution_path_in invariant FAILS, deliberately left that way. Measured post-CHAOS-3497 (world digest 2e1e254d..., errored 0, PR #1561): resolution_path is absent for reason 'empty-resolution-ledger'. The mechanism is NOT in this case -- a terminating preflight persists a dev_run_resolutions row for exactly ONE outcome (subject_preflight.py:595-599 passes terminating_resolution_entry only when entry.outcome is AMBIGUOUS_CANDIDATES; it is the only one of seven _terminate call sites that passes an entry at all). This case terminates on a different outcome, so nothing is persisted, derive_resolution_path returns None by contract, and resolution_path_in never matches None. Unsatisfiable BY CONSTRUCTION. CHAOS-3497 was predicted NOT to fix it and did not: 3497 makes the scope OUTCOME observable but does not touch ledger persistence, and this case staying red was pre-registered before that run rather than explained afterwards. DO NOT strip resolution_path_in as a fix -- that motion has already been made twice (23 cases in #1527, 18 in #1543) and this is the third population it produced; a fourth silent strip costs nine real assertions and does not stop a fifth. CHAOS-3533 owns the class and weighs the two real fixes: a structural predicate over 'terminates without an ambiguous candidate offer', or persisting the terminating entry on EVERY terminate.
